annotations.title: Plan and answer a multi-part question

description: Use this when a data-center question needs several kinds of data, e.g. "where could 200 MW land in Texas with fiber and short time to power?" or "compare Phoenix and Columbus for an AI campus". Pass the question unchanged as intent (query/question aliases accepted); optional hints (market, state, iso, lat, lon, capacity_mw). If intent is omitted, a US markets overview intent is used. A deterministic keyword planner (no language model) picks the lookups, runs them in order and returns each step with its own as_of and sources. Set dry_run to true to see the plan without running it. For a single lookup, the matching tool answers directly (evaluate_site, market_snapshot, grid_power). Returns headline step counts, one section per step, and an unavailable list for steps that could not run.

capacity_mw.description: Target load in megawatts, for example 200

dry_run.description: true returns the plan without running it; default false

intent.description: The question in plain language, passed unchanged

iso.description: Grid operator hint, for example ERCOT or PJM

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, for example 39.04

lon.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, for example -77.48

market.description: Market name or slug hint, for example phoenix

state.description: Two-letter US state hint, for example TX

name: plan_and_answer
title: Plan and answer a multi-part question
